Name: Sliced Fruits
Author: dollynhoevida
Description:
This mod adds 11 new fruit slices that are unlocked after foraging level 2.

Eating any fruit from the list gives a fruit slice that you can also eat.

Slice stats are different from the original fruits (Close to half the original fruit stats).

There is also a coconut slice crafting recipe.

List of fruit slices:
[spoiler]
Apple
Peach
Strawberry
Banana
Orange
Pomegranate
Mango
Pineapple
Melon
Powdermelon
[/spoiler]
Fruits still have their original stats and are not edited by this mod.
